title: ComfyUI v0.46.1 published on GitHub
summary: Comfy-Org released ComfyUI v0.46.1, delivering stability and patch fixes following the v0.46.0 cycle that introduced partner nodes and removed DirectML support.
research_notes:
Install ComfyUI or update an existing installation using git pull from the official repository or the desktop launcher.

Place diffusion checkpoint weights and text encoder models into the designated models directory.

Construct a workflow graph by wiring checkpoint loader, CLIP text encode, KSampler, and VAE decode nodes.

Queue prompt execution to run tensor generation and write output images using save image nodes.

Use standard CUDA or Apple Silicon backends rather than DirectML following the removal of DirectML acceleration in core releases.

Isolate custom node packages and test dependency updates in a staging environment to prevent node graph execution failures.
